manifest.author: Bill Whalen
manifest.description: Plays back scripted demo conversations from JSON files in storage, simulating agent responses for live demonstrations.
manifest.name: @discreetRappers/scripted_demo_agent

action.description: The action to perform. Options: 'list_demos' (list available demo files), 'load_demo' (load a demo and show its structure), 'respond' (match user input and return canned response)

demo_name.description: The name of the demo JSON file to load from Azure File Storage (without .json extension). Example: 'Bot_342_Morning_Greeting_Demo'

user_guid.description: Optional user GUID for context (used in demo responses that reference user data)

user_input.description: The user's message to match against the conversation flow and return the appropriate canned response
